name: hud_layout_sw_set_active
description: HudLayoutSW::SetActive updates the software viewport, activates sensor bounds/source clipping, and submits software span-occlusion rectangles for the sensor, shield message, and mode counters.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this viewport/span-occlusion path is deferred to the HUD layout class/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x412c60 shows the software acceleration reset, primary-surface width and HUD-origin active-rect update, HudLayout::ApplyViewportRect, active-only sensor bounds and child flag clearing, source clip setup, near-clip reciprocal calculation, and six zRndr::SpanOcclusionSubmitOccluderRect calls.
The native smoke covers inactive and active software paths, reset behavior, active-rect update, source clip state, and the submitted sensor and counter occluder polygons.
